name: ad/reels-ad-15s
description: Vertical 15 s ad: a hook on screen from frame 0, two or three value beats (text plus optional product capture), a proof line and a static end card for the last 2 s. Captions from cues in the bottom of the safe box; every claim is on screen for mute viewing.

headline.doc: The hook: on screen from frame 0 to 2.6 s, inside the ad safe box.

beats.doc: Two or three value beats: [{ text, image?, zoom?, focus? }]. text ≤ 10 words; image is a capture under assets/ (build --assets); zoom and focus override imageZoom and imageFocus for that capture.

proof.doc: One proof line (a number, a result, who uses it). Optional: without it the beats take its time.

cta.doc: The CTA on the end card (accent pill), static for the last 2 s.

url.doc: Short domain beside the CTA, optional.

legal.doc: Optional legal line on the end card.

captions.doc: Optional caption cues [{ start, end, text }] in seconds, ≤ 2 lines of ≤ 32 characters each. Rendered above the platform UI band; cues are cut at the end card.

imageFocus.doc: CSS object-position for every capture crop.

imageZoom.doc: Crop zoom into the captures (1 = fitted by cover); each beat pushes 6% further.
